description: The road section of the ONTL GeoPortal offers interactive dashboards on road transport in Brazil. One presents the main figures on federal highway infrastructure using data from the national transport infrastructure department DNIT (national road system version SNV 202501A) and the land transport agency ANTT; another shows crashes on federal highways from Federal Highway Police (PRF) records for 2016 to 2023; and a third shows traffic volumes in both directions from DNIT's National Traffic Counting Plan (PNCT). The portal has a search function with autocomplete. Coverage: Brazilian federal highways. Format and access: dashboards without registration. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated. Caveats: dashboards, not downloads; the underlying DNIT and PRF sources hold the raw data. It supports network flow and hazard exposure studies of the federal road network. It relates to the integrated transport planning open data, the ONTL cost simulator and DNIT pavement condition data in the catalogue.
